facts.text: The hotel is in Nob Hill, set within a 1909 Neoclassical landmark building.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury hotel in Nob Hill, San Francisco, is set within a 1909 Neoclassical landmark building, right next door to Union Square.

facts.text: A cable car stops right outside the hotel's doors.
facts.excerpt: hopping on the cable car right outside our doors to explore sites like Fisherman’s Wharf and Ghirardelli Square

facts.text: Signature Suites are on the Club Level on the top floors of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located on the Club Level on the top floors of the iconic hotel, these luxury 1- and 2-bedroom hotel suites in San Francisco

facts.text: The one-bedroom Presidential Suite has a furnished terrace overlooking the city's Financial District.
facts.excerpt: with a unique 1,200 sq. ft. terrace overlooking the city's Financial District

facts.text: The one-bedroom Ritz-Carlton Suite has views of Coit Tower, Alcatraz Island and the San Francisco Bay.
facts.excerpt: Boasting views of Coit Tower, Alcatraz Island, and the San Francisco Bay, the one-bedroom Ritz-Carlton Suite is a spacious 1,980 sq. ft.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations four times each day: breakfast, lunch, evening hors d’oeuvres and cocktails, and desserts.
facts.excerpt: Four times each day, our San Francisco hotel with concierge services offers complimentary food and beverage presentations in the Club Lounge.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
facts.excerpt: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

facts.text: Parallel 37 is the hotel restaurant and serves Californian cuisine crafted with local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Savor breakfast at Parallel 37, our hotel restaurant in San Francisco that serves Californian cuisine crafted with local ingredients.

facts.text: Bruma pairs city-inspired cocktails with modern California cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Rooted in Nob Hill and inspired by San Francisco’s iconic fog, Bruma pairs city-inspired cocktails with modern California cuisine.

facts.text: The Ritz Kids program includes a special registration experience for children and a scavenger hunt.
facts.excerpt: From a special registration experience just for kids to a discovery-filled scavenger hunt

facts.text: In the evenings the hotel offers complimentary car service for trips within a one-mile radius.
facts.excerpt: In the evenings, the hotel also offers complimentary car service for trips within a one-mile radius of the property.

facts.text: Families can stay in two-bedroom connecting suites with city views.
facts.excerpt: Families enjoy a memorable vacation in spacious two-bedroom connecting luxury hotel suites in San Francisco, CA, with beautiful city views and kid-friendly amenities.

facts.text: Rooms have pillow-top mattresses and 100% combed cotton linens.
facts.excerpt: Our San Francisco luxury accommodations feature pillow-top mattresses and 100% combed cotton linens

facts.text: On-site valet parking is available for a daily fee.
facts.excerpt: On-site valet parking is available at The Ritz-Carlton, San Francisco. The daily valet fee is $107.00 per day.

facts.text: Breakfast at Parallel 37 is available for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Parallel 37 for a fee.
